content: Cida mumuga tabuidi

Wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega tutaina Yesu ꞌihetomotai muya ꞌilobeya, ma ꞌimi nuwatuhu walagu Yesu gidemusa, ma ꞌoinega waboimo wagihepaꞌaligomi, weyahina ꞌeguma taiyawedi taudi wahidiyega muya silobediya, ꞌidi mumuga galana ꞌigumwala pwaiya.
Coinega ꞌida tuta mabwaiyana baleꞌuwa tamiyamiya tatagwalegita Yehoba ꞌoina ma tauna ꞌiloinaegita ma hesi ꞌida nuwaꞌubuna geyaꞌabwa ꞌiloloinaegita.

Mwalo ꞌimi mumuga galana gidemusa taudi tomiya ganamuli, ma mumugaedi bewa walogwahatedi, gidemusa sogala ma nuwaꞌubuna ma bwasi waiwaidi ꞌadi numa yauyaule, ma heꞌiyaꞌiyagu paihowa galadi weyahidi, ma wete hemisa ꞌaboꞌabodi hali ginaulao ꞌoidiya.
Ma tomiya ganamuliyedi sinuwa henainaida ꞌeguma ꞌomi geya mahetemiyao ginaulaedi galadi wapaipaihowadi, ꞌoinega siꞌahwa galagalaegomi.
Ma hesi Yehoba tomota mayawasidi ma ꞌamaꞌamasidi ꞌabwa ꞌibwaꞌomatadi, ma wete taudi tomiya ganamuli ꞌabwa siyatala matana.
Bewa huhuna ꞌoinega wasa bwebweꞌana ꞌiguguyaeya toꞌamasao ꞌoidiya, ma tuta mayawasidiya ꞌadi loina mwauna silobeya, ma ꞌane yaluyaluwadiyega yawasidi siꞌewa Yehoba ꞌoinega.
Muhemuhena ginaula mabwaiyana sigumwala. Coinega waꞌitayahigomi ma ꞌimi nuwatuhuwao wagihepaꞌalidi, ma tuta baibaiwana waꞌahwaꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina.
Coinega wahelau hilegomi moisa ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoimiya, weyahina helau sawasawahina ma galana baibaiwadi ꞌigibodi.
Coinega ꞌiyamiyao wabwauwedi ꞌimi hada, nuwa bwebweꞌanega, ma geyaꞌabwa walolomugiyedi.
Ma ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda Yehoba heguheguyai hagana ma hagana ꞌiꞌebwae pwaigomiya, ꞌoinega heguheguyaiyedi ꞌoidiyega wapaihowa ma ꞌiyamiyao walemedi, ma ꞌoinega ꞌomi Yehoba ꞌina topaihowa bwebweꞌami.

Ceguma taiyawedi ꞌomi wahetohepwaila, wahetohepwaila tuwa gidemusa Yehoba ꞌina gwae wahepwaileya, ma ꞌeguma taiyawedi ꞌomi walemalema, walema tuwa ꞌimi waiwai mabwaiyanega, gidemusa waiwaiina ꞌiꞌebwaegomiya, ma ꞌoinega paihowa mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiyega tomota Yesu Keliso sisanapu ma Yehoba sihepwatuwe, weyahina tauna wasawasa moisa ma tohewaiwai moisa, tuta mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya. Emeni.
Yesu ꞌina tomotaiyao siꞌemuyamuya
Ma tasigwao, geyaꞌabwa maꞌimi henainaida ꞌeguma tutaina ꞌebe tohona mwaudi walobadi. Geyaꞌabwa wanuwanuwatuhu ꞌabehega silatulatu daita,
ma hesi wayaliyaya, ma wete wanuwatuhu ꞌabehega Yesu Keliso muya ꞌilobeya, eeta ꞌomi gidemusa tuwa waloba ꞌese, ma muliyetega tutaina ꞌina wasawasa ꞌihapwesama wayaliyaya madou hedada.
Ma ꞌeguma tomota siꞌahwa galagalaegomi ꞌimi hemisa Keliso ꞌoina weyahina, wayaliyaya tuwa, weyahina Yehoba yaluyaluwana ꞌasiꞌasilalaina ꞌoimiya ꞌimiyamiya.
Ma hesi geya ginaula bwebweꞌadi weyahimi ꞌeguma waloheꞌamasa bo wayagaha bo wapui bo wapaihowa besobeso ma weyahidi muya waloba.
Ma ginaula bwebweꞌana hesi ꞌeguma ꞌomi Keliso ꞌina bodao ma muya waloba. Beno geya ꞌebe debamwadina, ma hesi Yehoba wahepwatuwe, weyahina ꞌomi Keliso ꞌina bodao moisa.

Ma tuta ꞌilatu pwaima ma ꞌane bwaꞌomatana ꞌihegaina, ma ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌina tomotaiyao ꞌida bwaꞌomatana nugetedi, eema muliyetega taudi wasana bwebweꞌana geya sihemihemise, ꞌidi galao ꞌana maisa mwau hedada siloba.
Ma Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌihepwaila pwaiya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Yehoba ꞌoina mwauna ma ꞌabehega tobwebweꞌadi ꞌiꞌabihetedi, ma hesi togidega togala, taudi Yehoba ꞌana tologwahatao? Taudi beno ꞌadi ꞌabihetena mwau hedada.”

content: Coinega ꞌeguma ꞌomi Yehoba ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌoinega muya walobalobadi, yawasimi watagwaledi tauna ꞌoina, ma ꞌane ꞌiꞌitayahigomi, weyahina tauna ꞌada Topaihowa bwebweꞌana moisa, ma ꞌomi wete gidemusa wamumuga bwebweꞌana.
